titleEn: Reduce Array Size to The Half
title: 数组大小减半
summary: 选择尽量少的不同整数并删除它们的所有出现，使数组剩余长度不超过原来一半，返回最少选择数。
insight: 每选择一个值的成本相同，收益是其频次，因此按频次从大到小删除总能用最少值达到目标。
pitfalls: 要删除至少向上取整的一半元素
每次选择会删除该值全部出现

solutions.title: 频次降序贪心
solutions.idea: 优先删除出现次数最多的值。
steps: 取所有频次列表降序排序
removed 累加频次、answer++，直到 removed*2>=n，返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int minSetSize(int[] arr){Map<Integer,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();for(int value:arr)frequency.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);List<Integer> counts=new ArrayList<>(frequency.values());counts.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());int removed=0,answer=0;for(int count:counts){removed+=count;answer++;if(removed*2>=arr.length)break;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSetSize(arr:IntArray):Int{val frequency=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();for(value in arr)frequency[value]=(frequency[value]?:0)+1;var removed=0;var answer=0;for(count in frequency.values.sortedDescending()){removed+=count;answer++;if(removed*2>=arr.size)break};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minSetSize(vector<int>& arr){unordered_map<int,int> frequency;for(int value:arr)++frequency[value];vector<int> counts;for(auto [value,count]:frequency)counts.push_back(count);sort(counts.rbegin(),counts.rend());int removed=0,answer=0;for(int count:counts){removed+=count;++answer;if(removed*2>=(int)arr.size())break;}return answer;} };
